long_biography.plain_text:
Philip Gonda joined Victor Guasch in turning a centuries-old Ibiza finca into Atzaró, which opened as a boutique hotel in 2004. The estate came from Guasch's family; Gonda's role was as business partner and co-owner, not heir to the land.

That first hotel became the base of a wider hospitality platform. The partners developed restaurants and lodging in Ibiza and Cape Town before adding an Okavango safari camp with African Bush Camps. Gonda was closely involved in creating the hotel's large organic garden, linking the guest experience to produce grown on site. His ownership is in the hospitality group and its ventures; family land, partnership assets and operating-company property remain distinct from his personal estate.
